paper.title: Online Stochastic Optimization under Correlated Bandit Feedback

settings.name_in_paper: X-armed bandit with iid rewards (HCT-iid setting)
unmapped: Arm space is a general measurable space with a dissimilarity function (not necessarily a metric) and a given hierarchical covering tree
Local smoothness only w.r.t. the maximizer: f* - f(x) <= l(x*, x) (weaker than Lipschitz)
Complexity measured by near-optimality dimension d_near with constant C_cov
The learner knows the smoothness parameters nu_1 and rho of the covering tree
settings.definition_quote: At each time step $t$, the learner pulls an arm $x_t$ in $\mathcal X$ and the environment returns a reward $r_{t}\in[0,1]$ ... Assume that at each step $t$, the reward $r_t$, conditioned on $x_t$, is independent of all prior random events and the immediate mean reward $f(x)=\mathbb E(r|x)$ exists for every $x\in \mathcal X$.

settings.name_in_paper: X-armed bandit with correlated bandit feedback (HCT-Gamma setting)
settings.out_of_scope_reason: Rewards and contexts depend on the whole history (ergodic process with finite mixing time, covers policy search in MDPs); history-dependent/Markovian reward processes are out of scope in v0.5.
unmapped: Rewards and observed contexts may depend on the entire history of pulls, rewards and contexts
Ergodicity: time-average reward of an arm converges in expectation to f(x) regardless of history
Finite mixing time Gamma: |E[sum_{s'=s}^S (r_{s'}(x) - f(x)) | F_{s-1}]| <= Gamma
The learner knows the mixing time Gamma and the smoothness parameters nu_1, rho
Arm space with a dissimilarity function and covering tree; local smoothness only w.r.t. the maximizer; near-optimality dimension d_near
settings.definition_quote: The context $y_{t}$ and the reward $r_t$ may depend on the history of all previous rewards, pulls, contexts and the current pull $x_t$. ... There exists a constant $\Gamma\geq 0$ (mixing time) such that ... $|\E[  \sum{_{s'=s}^S (r_{s'}(x) - f(x))}  \big| \F_{s-1}]| \leq \Gamma$.

conditions: Assumptions 3-5 (dissimilarity, local smoothness w.r.t. maximizer, near-optimality dimension)
rewards in [0,1] iid given the arm

source.label: thm:hct.iid
source.quote: Pick a  $\delta\in(0,1)$. Assume that at each step $t$, the reward $r_t$, conditioned on $x_t$, is independent of all prior random events and the immediate mean reward $f(x)=\mathbb E(r|x)$ exists for every $x\in \mathcal X$. Then under Assumptions~\ref{asm:dissim}--\ref{asm:near.optimal.dim} the regret of \HCTiid in $n$ steps is, with probability (w.p.) $1-\delta$, $R_n \leq O\big(\big(\log \left(n/\delta\right)\big)^{1/(d+2)}n^{(d+1)/(d+2)}\big)$.

results.notes: Regret R_n = n f* - sum r_t (realized), bounded w.p. 1-delta. d is the near-optimality dimension (renamed d_near). Union bound over all n gives anytime validity. Runtime O(n log n).

symbols.nu_2: inner-ball constant of the covering tree
symbols.rho: shrinkage rate of the covering tree, in (0,1)

conditions: rewards in [0,1], independent of the past given the arm

source.label: thm:hct.corr
source.quote: We assume that Assumptions~\ref{asm:ergod}--\ref{asm:near.optimal.dim} hold and that rewards are generated according to the general model defined in Section~\ref{s:preliminaries}. Then the regret of \HCTiid after $n$ steps is, w.p. $1-\delta$, $R_n \leq O\Big(\big(\log \left(n/\delta\right)\big)^{1/(d+2)}n^{(d+1)/(d+2)}\Big)$.
